sentences.text: You leave an eight hundred fix on course one two five true at ten knots.
At nine hundred, plot a DR ten miles along that course.
At nine thirty you change course, so plot a DR there, five more miles along one two five.
From that nine thirty DR, draw the new course line at one six zero true, and at ten hundred plot a DR five miles along it.
Label each position with its time.
If you get a fix along the way, start a fresh DR track from the fix.
